query:
SELECT EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM task t
               WHERE t.detached_from = ? AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date <= ?
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                     SELECT 1 FROM completion c
                     WHERE c.task_id = t.id AND c.occurrence_date IS t.due_date
                 )
           ) AS "exists!: bool"
